quest.title: A Strange Story in Konda
quest.description: A mysterious, masked shrine maiden is by the strange fox statue, seemingly with something to request of you...

talks.objective: Talk to the mysterious shrine maiden

dialogues.text: Excuse me, busy Traveler, but I have a favor to ask.
Please, look at the Sky Kitsune Statue over there.
There is a ward within it that they say can only be removed by someone who has courage, values friendship, and who is favored by the might of <color=#00E1FFFF>Electro</color>.
